memory_pair_rule: native request 4096; minimize absolute filled live requested bytes among WF 4096/5120/6144/8192; tie smaller WF request; label comparable iff larger/smaller <=1.10

timing_results.timed_independent_oracle: Each warmup and recorded sample was checked by the existing independent C key-ID/content/outcome oracle; measurement command exited 0. No new benchmark or oracle replay was run.

reduction_rule: Group by cohort, payload bytes, requested capacity, path and implementation; median of all 11 samples. Ratios divide cohort medians; spread is 100*(max cohort ratio/min cohort ratio-1). No sample is removed. Sensitivity compares WF at each larger capacity to WF4096. Requested-memory comparisons use preselected WF capacity and native4096.
